m.pg: Money making guide/Making raw admiral pie
m.h:
Raw admiral pies are used to quickly train Cooking and Magic by using the Bake Pie spell. They are made by using the ingredients (Salmon, Tuna, Raw potato) on a Pie shell, in that order. To avoid losing money, test out the profit of making one pie before you do them in bulk.

Buy an equal number of pie shells, salmon, tuna and raw potatoes from the Grand Exchange (each has a buying limit of 1,000 per four hours). Withdraw 14 pie shells and 14 salmon, and use one on the other. This will bring up a menu to make part admiral pies, so click to make-all. Once you've made 14, bank them and repeat. When all of your salmon and pie shells are gone, use the tuna on the part summer pies in the same fashion, and then use the raw potatoes on the part admiral pies (tuna) to create raw admiral pies. Adding an ingredient 14 times will take about 20 seconds including banking, so you can make up to 840 raw admiral pies per hour.

You can then sell the pies on the Grand Exchange. To maximise your profit, buy one raw admiral pie at the instant price, and then sell all of yours for that price.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making raw summer pies
m.h:
Raw summer pies are used to quickly train Cooking and Magic by using the Bake Pie spell. They are made by using the ingredients (Strawberry, Watermelon, Cooking apple) on a Pie shell, in that order.

To avoid losing money, test out the profit of making one pie before you do them in bulk.

  1. Buy an equal number of pie shells, strawberries, watermelons and cooking apples from the Grand Exchange (each has a buying limit of 1,000 per four hours)
  2. Withdraw 14 pie shells and 14 strawberries, and use one on the other. This will bring up a menu to make part summer pies, click make-all
  3. Once you've made 14, bank them and repeat
  4. When all of your strawberries and pie shells are gone, use all of your watermelons on the part summer pies
  5. Then use the cooking apples on the part summer pies (watermelon) to create raw summer pies.

Adding an ingredient 14 times will take about 20 seconds including banking, so you can make up to 840 raw summer pies per hour.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making sacred oil

rq.nt: for instantly building the Flamtaer temple. Recommended if solo

m.h:
Sacred oil is used to make pyre logs, used to cremate vyre corpses for rewards. Players are often unwilling to create it, as the process is slow and complicated. Sacred oil is made by using olive oil on the pyre at the Flamtaer temple in Mort'ton during the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. The temple needs to be repaired, and nearby shades need to be kept in check. Both of these actions generate sanctity, which is then spent to create the sacred oil and is individual to the player. Each 4-dose vial of olive oil requires 3.6 sanctity to sanctify, and no oil can be sanctified unless you have at least 10 sanctity.

On world 88, the official world for this activity, there will usually be players maintaining the temple. If this is the case, you can focus almost entirely on killing the nearby loar shades as quickly as possible. Using a halberd with multi-target abilities such as two handed Adaptive Strike and Hurricane, you can kill shades very quickly. However, using ranged or magic lets you target the shades from further away, which is useful if you have to compete with other players for kills.

Each shade has 4000 life points, and grants 2 sanctity when killed. With 100 sanctity you will be able to sanctify 26 vials of olive oil, after which you will have roughly 6 sanctity left. Thus you will have to gather sanctity twice (or even three times if using a pack yak or pack mammoth) per trip. The loar shades also have a chance of dropping useful items such as the deployable herb burner, the ectoplasmator, pieces of the ghost hunter outfit, and the cremation ability.

You may want to help repair the temple while waiting for shades to respawn, especially if there are other players killing them as well. The temple is repaired using resources. Interacting with a temple wall while having a timber beam, a limestone brick and five swamp paste in your inventory will grant you one resource. Unlike sanctity, you don't lose resources over time, so you should prepare them in advance if you think you might want to use any. Timber beams and swamp paste stack, and all the items needed for resources are sold by Razmire Keelgan in Mort'ton.

You may save some money by buying olive oil from Razmire Keelgan instead of the Grand Exchange - Razmire Keeligan stocks 500 3-dose vials at 26 gp each, which are upgraded to 4-dose vials (at the same price) if you've completed the medium Morytania tasks. For comparison, the current Grand Exchange prices of 3- and 4-dose vials are 948 gp and 1,471 gp respectively.

Once you have a full load of sacred oil, you should head to a bank. If you have unlocked the War's Retreat teleport and have defeated the Barrows Brothers at least once, teleporting to War's Retreat, then returning via a boss portal attuned to the Barrows is by far the fastest way to bank.

Alternatively, if you have completed Desert Treasure and have unlocked the shortcut between Canifis and Mort'ton by playing Temple Trekking, using a bank teleport to get to a bank, then returning using Kharyrll Teleport or the Canifis lodestone is also quick.

If neither of these is an option, the bank in Burgh de Rott is the best option. This can be sped up using Drakan's medallion after The Branches of Darkmeyer.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making scentless potions
m.h:
Since being made tradeable, Scentless potions have become popular among players wanting to train hunter quickly. They are also used to make Perfect juju agility potions, which are used by some players when training Agility. Unlike most potions, the scentless potion requires an untradeable secondary ingredient, and one which is considered somewhat tedious to gather at that. For these reasons, scentless potions have become significantly more valuable than their unfinished version, with a profit of at least 4115 - 1664 gp per potion awaiting those willing to gather the shadow vines required.

Shadow vines are gathered by hunting Shadow jadinkos using a noose wand. Before hunting shadow jadinkos, they must first be attracted to the habitat. This is done by building an abandoned house and planting a red blossom seed. The former either requires level 57 Construction or costs 57,000 gp, while the latter requires level 54 Farming (though the Assist System can be used). This only needs to be done once, unless the house and/or flower is later replaced.

While the size of the area and the large number of searchable objects might suggest that tracking jadinkos is complex, there are only a handful of paths, each requiring searching only three objects.

Starting from the east burrow, there is only one possible path. This path is relatively long and ends near the west burrow. Starting from the west burrow, there are three possible paths to follow. Two of these are relatively long and end near the east burrow, while the last is much shorter than all the rest and ends near the west burrow. The presence of a shorter path, and thus the shorter average path length, makes the west burrow more attractive. However, if the player is already standing much closer to the east burrow, starting there and following that path is better than running across the entire habitat to get to the west burrow.

Upon having gathered a satisfactory number of shadow vines (nine for every ten unfinished potions if using the Scroll of Cleansing, or one for each if not), the next step is to make the potions. This is done by simply adding the vines to the unfinished potions. Using the Modified botanist's mask, Portable wells, the Factory outfit, the Scroll of cleansing and Botanist's amulets to save vines or produce extra potions is highly recommended at this stage. As most of those are untradable and some have relatively high requirements, only the botanist's amulet, portable well and scroll of cleansing are included in the profit calculations. All together, these boosts will allow you to create an average of 1.38 potions per vine, compared to just 1 potion per vine without any of them.

Since the shadow vines stack, no inventory space will be cleared while making the potions, meaning any strange or golden rocks you find will end up destroying a potion unless you are wearing the Statue collection bag.

Depending on current prices, it may be more profitable to decant all potions to 3 or 4 doses before selling. This can be done by Bob Barter (herbs) at the Grand Exchange, Rhobert Dail (herbs) at the Tower of Voices, or Rhodri Dail at the Max Guild. Currently, 4-dose potions are worth 2,350.25 gp per dose, while 3-dose potions are worth 1,371.67 gp per dose.

This guide uses a figure of 110 jadinkos caught and 121 potions made each hour. This is only an estimate, made from limited testing at level 99 hunter. Low-level players might not be able to reach these numbers, while high level players may be able to surpass them.

m.t: Making steel of legends scrolls during the the Amlodd Voice of Seren
m.pg: Money making guide/Making steel of legends scrolls during the Amlodd Voice of Seren

rq.h: or Attuned crystal teleport seed or Master camouflage outfit
or TokKul-Zo or Ring of duelling

m.h:
Steel Titan scroll (Steel of Legends)s provide an enormously powerful special attack for the steel titan, and they are often used while killing high-levelled monsters or in player killing. Because most players choose to buy these scrolls on the Grand Exchange instead of making them, there is lots of profit in turning steel titan pouches into scrolls.

To start off, buy steel titan pouches on the Grand Exchange. They have a buying limit of 5,000 per four hours. To save money, find the lowest price that others are buying the pouches for, and put in an offer slightly lower than theirs. It will take longer to fulfil, but it will greatly increase the profit.

The best way to make scrolls is at the Amlodd obelisk during the Amlodd Voice of Seren. Begin by summoning a Beast of Burden, and withdrawing 28 steel titan pouches into both your inventory and your beast of burden. Use the attuned crystal teleport seed to teleport to the Amlodd district, and run to the Obelisk. Use your pouches on the obelisk, and they will be made into scrolls. Withdraw from your beast of burden, and use your pouches on the obelisk again. Teleport to a bank by using TokKul-Zo (if you've completed The Elder Kiln) or a ring of duelling or the attuned crystal teleport seed (Ithell district). Bank your scrolls and repeat. Each run takes 17 seconds, so you can use around 9,137 pouches per hour using a Pack mammoth. This produces around 110,104 scrolls per hour.

You can decrease the travel time and increase the overall profit per hour by keybinding your Attuned crystal teleport seed as well as using the Surge ability with the Mobile perk.

After you've made all of your scrolls, sell them on the Grand Exchange. The efficiency of this method may depend on current market trends, so it would be wise to to try to maximise your profit by buying one of the scrolls instantly, and selling yours for slightly more than that.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making super prayer potions
m.h:
The rates assume 2200 potions are mixed per hour with the scroll of cleansing, portable wells, Brooch of the Gods, modified botanist mask, 3 pieces of the factory outfit and botanist's amulets. Always make sure to check prices before you invest heavily into the method.

Grinding wyvern bones

Before being able to start making potions you will need to create Ground wyvern bones.

The most effective way of doing this is using Telekinetic Grind:

  1. Create a Preset of 28 Wyvern bones in your inventory, and a Small rune pouch or better in your pocket slot with law runes and astral runes on Preset 1 or 2
  2. Then Keybind Telekinetic Grind onto the same Key as your preset
  3. Go to an Empty world with lowest ping, and move your bag interface so its next to the bank (so its minimal mouse movement)
  4. Then Press Preset, press again, click a Wyvern bones, immediately click the bank
  5. Repeat the previous step until all desired Ground wyvern bones are created
Mixing ingredients

The guide has assumed that it will take you 5 seconds to do an inventory, in reality 2-3 second inventories are very manageable.

After all the Ground wyvern bones are created, go to world 84 Lumbridge Market if you're not using your own portable wells. It is possible to obtain rates of up to 2800 potions per hour by using a Beast of Burden such as a Pack Yak along with bank presets to optimise time spent potion making. This will require a higher intensity in order to manage both inventories. The guide has assumed a potion making rate of 2500 per hour.

Even if you opt to not actively use a Beast of Burden, it is still recommended to use one in order to better utilise the ingredients saved by the Scroll of Cleansing. For this method, the inventory setup should be 15 Prayer potion (3) and 13 Ground wyvern bones, along with 2 Ground wyvern bones in a beast of burden.

It is recommended to use your own portable wells on a world which you have a good connection to as the benefits outweigh the costs in most cases.

When selling the potions it's generally best to decant to 4 dose potions first for the best price. However, it may be more profitable to sell in 3 dose.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making super prayer renewal potions
m.h:
This guide assumes that potions are mixed per hour. The experience rate assumes the usage of a portable well, maximum potency torstol incense sticks, maximum advanced pulse core boost, and the maximum clan avatar boost.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making the Spear of Annihilation

inp.nt: [[Dungeoneering token|Dungeoneering token]] 100000 are required to create each [[Spear of Annihilation]]

m.h:
This profit rate assumes 566 material digs an hour. Actual profit may be higher or lower depending on archaeology level, drop rates, and other boosts or invention perks.

To make a spear of Annihilation, a spear of Annihilation tip has to be obtained first. Spear of Annihilation tips can be obtained by excavating the Bandos's sanctum debris excavation hotspot in the Warforge Dig Site.

The spear of Annihilation tip has a 1/50000 chance to be obtained upon successfully excavating a material. Thus, increasing the chance to receive materials should be prioritised to obtain higher profit rates. The following have an impact on the chance to receive materials:

  • Focus - Higher level mattocks provide a higher focus. The guildmaster Tony's mattock has the highest focus, but due to its price, a mattock of Time and Space would likely be the best option.
  • Master archaeologist's outfit - Provides a 7% increase to materials received.
  • Balarak's sash brush - Provides a 10% increase to materials received.
  • Honed - Each rank of honed provides a 2% increase to materials received.
  • Material manual - Provides a 10% increase to materials received. The cost of a manual may be higher than the expected increase in profit, therefore, only use material manuals if the output above is higher than 11,760,000 gp.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making torstol incense sticks

rq.h: or Pyro-matic or Augmented crystal tinderbox (recommended)

m.h:
Torstol incense sticks are used by wealthy players for their global experience boost. While it would technically be faster to use infernal magic incense sticks in the process, there is no profit margin for whoever makes those, and as such they will hardly ever be found on the Grand Exchange. It takes 5 ticks to apply the ashes to the sticks, then 6 ticks to apply the herb to the ashed sticks. Accounting for some extra time for banking, 500 ashed and herbed incense sticks per hour is a reasonable expectation.

The Prayer experience from ashing the magic incense sticks is identical to the experience from scattering the infernal ashes, but unlike typical Prayer and Firemaking training methods, incense turns the logs and ashes into a sellable product rather than simply being destroyed, making it a rare method of training either skill that can actually make money in the process. It is slower Prayer XP than scattering the ashes due to the time required per ash and about half the time being taken up with applying the herb instead, to say nothing of using altars for Prayer training, but it is Prayer XP at a profit nonetheless.

Other incense types may be profitable, but Torstol and Fellstalk generate the most Prayer XP, and incenses below Cadantine generate significantly less due to using Impious or Accursed rather than Infernal, which grant much less Prayer XP each.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making ultracompost
m.h: With Infernus pyroclasts tradeable on the Grand Exchange, ultracompost production is no longer limited by the manure dropping rate of dragons at the Anachronia dinosaur farm. There are 7 compost bins, allowing for 105 buckets of ultracompost roughly every 90 minutes, effectively 70 buckets an hour. Compost bin locations: Manor Farm, Catherby, Taverley, South Falador, East of Canifis, Herblore Habitat, and Prifddinas

m.pg: Money making guide/Making ultracompost (infernus pyroclasts)

rq.nt: required to access the Sydekix's Shop of Balance
unlocked from Sydekix's Shop of Balance

m.h:
With the release of Garden of Kharid, the process for making compost has been streamlined:

  1. Deposit 1,000 noted infernus pyroclasts into any compost bin
  2. Return after about 28 hours to collect the ultracompost and deposit it to a tool leprechaun until the compost bin is empty
    • A quick way to do this while avoiding the UI is to "use" the ultracompost on the leprechaun, typing in any number 28 or above (99 works) into the prompt and hitting enter
  3. Withdraw the ultracompost from the tool leprechaun in noted form (via the "Noted-X" option in the storage interface) and sell it

The Buckets All the Way Down unlock at Sydekix's Shop of Balance is necessary to remove the need for buckets, increasing profits. It takes roughly 20 minutes to withdraw the 1,000 ultracompost from the bin.

Empty bucket packs, containing 50 noted buckets each, can be purchased from some shops.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making unfinished avantoe potions
m.h:
Avantoe potion (unfinished) are used to create super energy potions. Because these are often used to train Herblore, and adding clean avantoe to a vial of water gives little experience, many players avoid the tedium of making unfinished potions and buy them directly from the Grand Exchange.

Using portable wells gives a 5% chance of making an extra potion and the scroll of cleansing gives a permanent 10% chance of not using up an ingredient when making potions. The bonuses of these two items increase the number of unfinished potions you can make, and the portable well also makes the process less click-intensive. With a portable well placed next to a bank chest, click on the bank chest and deposit your inventory and withdraw 14 herbs and 14 vials of water by using a bank preset, and repeat.

There is usually a portable well placed and maintained by someone else next to the bank chest in the Lumbridge Market in world 84. However, if there isn't one and no-one else provides one within a reasonable amount of time, you may have to use your own wells. Assuming the portable wells are bought at Grand Exchange prices, this will cost 19,248 gp coins per hour. 2,310 Avantoe potions can be made on an average raising the money per hour to .
